$comment: Signal's regional restrictions and terms version — the ONE place they are set. The Cloudflare Worker (functions/compliance.js) reads it to answer /api/geo and to refuse launch registration and trade building; the site reads the result from /api/geo. To move a country between levels, move its entry from one level's "countries" to the other's; no code changes are needed. Country codes are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 as sent by Cloudflare (CF-IPCountry / request.cf.country). Changing termsVersion re-prompts every visitor to accept the terms. DRAFT pending legal review.

blocked.$comment: Level 1. No wallet connect, launch or trade; browsing is allowed with a clear notice.
blocked.notice: Signal isn't available in your region. You can browse, but connecting a wallet, launching tokens and trading are disabled.

CN.name: Mainland China
CN.note: Mainland China only. Hong Kong (HK), Macau (MO) and Taiwan (TW) are separate codes and are not blocked.

regions.$comment: Comprehensively sanctioned territories, detected from Cloudflare's request.cf.regionCode (ISO 3166-2 subdivision, keyed here as COUNTRY-REGION). LIMITATION: this is IP geolocation of a region, which is less reliable than country detection; many IPs in these territories geolocate to Russia (RU) or to another Ukrainian region, and those are not caught. Treat this as best effort, not a guarantee.

regulated.$comment: Level 2. Allowed, but the visitor must tick an extra region-specific warning when accepting the terms. To block one of these instead, move its entry to levels.blocked.countries.

GB.name: United Kingdom
GB.warning: UK financial-promotion rules can apply to cryptoasset communications capable of having an effect in the UK, including online communications from overseas firms. Signal does not provide financial advice. Access to or use of Signal does not mean that any token, project or promotion has been approved by the FCA. Additional restrictions may apply to UK users.

US.name: United States
US.warning: In the United States, laws and regulatory requirements may apply differently depending on the token, activity and state. These can include federal and state rules relating to securities, commodities, money transmission and trading services. Signal does not provide legal or financial advice. You are responsible for complying with laws that apply to you.

ZA.name: South Africa
ZA.warning: In South Africa, crypto assets are regulated as financial products under the FAIS Act. Certain businesses providing financial services in relation to crypto assets must be authorised by the FSCA. Signal is not currently an FSCA-authorised financial services provider. Signal does not provide financial advice. You use Signal on your own initiative and remain responsible for your wallet and every transaction you approve.

notes: Syria is deliberately not blocked. Syria's sanctions changed in 2026, and whether it belongs in a level must follow the current sanctions framework at the time, not an older list. Review before adding it.
Blocking is by IP location, which VPNs and proxies can bypass. The terms also require users to confirm they are not in a blocked jurisdiction and are not a sanctioned person.
Cloudflare reports Tor traffic as T1 and unknown locations as XX. Neither is blocked here; they are treated as location unknown.

Level 3 (sanctioned wallets) is not a list in this file: wallets are screened at connect, launch registration and trade building against the digital currency addresses in the US Treasury's OFAC SDN list. A scheduled GitHub Actions job (.github/workflows/ofac-sdn-list.yml) downloads the official SDN.XML every 6 hours and publishes the addresses to the ofac-data branch, which the Worker reads (functions/compliance.js), from GitHub or, if that fails, its jsDelivr mirror; Cloudflare itself can't connect to Treasury's server. A list more than 48 hours old is not used, and a failed read is retried after at most 30 seconds. No key is needed.
